character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A young man in his early 20s, chibi-style proportions with a slightly large head, messy spiky medium-length brown hair, large dark brown eyes, calm friendly face. Wearing a dark green pullover hoodie with a front pocket, black trousers, black and white sneakers, and a black backpack on his back. Neutral standing pose, arms relaxed at sides. Clean pixels, flat colors with simple shading, dark outline, no anti-aliasing.
